sloka: मालेस्तु वसुधा नाम गन्धर्वी रूपशालिनी ।भार्यासीत्पद्मपत्राक्षी स्वक्षी यक्षीवरोपमा ।। ७.५.४२ ॥
transliteration: mālestu vasudhā nāma gandharvī rūpaśālinī ।bhāryāsītpadmapatrākṣī svakṣī yakṣīvaropamā ।। 7.5.42 ॥

translations.english: Mali's wife was a beautiful Gandharva woman named Vasudha, who had eyes like lotus petals and was as splendid as a chief Yakshini.
